description: List all running Java/JVM processes on the current machine. Returns process ID (PID) and the main class or JAR name for each. Use this to check if a specific Java application has started, or to find the PID of a running Java service for debugging. Prefers 'jps' (JDK tool) when JDK is installed; falls back to 'ps'.
name: java_processes

count.description: The total number of Java processes returned.

message.description: Human-readable summary of the query result. Example: 'Found 2 Java process(es)'.

main_class.description: Main class name or executable JAR name of the Java process.

runtime.description: Java runtime implementation or distribution, such as 'OpenJDK', 'Oracle JDK', 'Temurin', or other detected JVM.

filter.description: Optional. Case-insensitive substring to filter results. Example: 'Spring' to find Spring Boot apps, 'hermes' to find the specific JAR/service.

full.description: When true, returns JVM arguments (e.g. -Xmx, -D props) for each process. Default: false (fast, just PID + class name).
